text:
This Seedance 2 prompt is absolutely brutal A cybernetic berserker charging through an entire army like a goddamn force of nature. 🔥
 #DreaminaCPP @dreamina_ai

PROMPT
A cybernetic berserker with glowing orange energy veins, exposed mechanical jaw, dual flaming chain blades spinning violently in his hands
Charges into a massive army of armored soldiers at impossible speed, carving through enemies while explosions erupt around him and entire vehicles split apart from the force of his attacks
Industrial warzone with burning tanks, sparks raining from broken machinery, smoke and fire filling the horizon
Begins with aggressive handheld close-up on his glowing eyes, sudden speed ramp into full sprint, whip pans linking brutal kills, crash zoom during giant explosions, orbit shot while sparks and blood spray across the frame, heavy motion blur amplifying speed and impact, ending with the berserker roaring on top of a burning tank mountain while the battlefield behind collapses into flames and detonations, camera slowly circling around his silhouette as ash falls from the sky

Watch this 
This is straight-up blockbuster VFX level now.
content:
A cybernetic berserker with glowing orange energy veins, exposed mechanical jaw, dual flaming chain blades spinning violently in his hands
Charges into a massive army of armored soldiers at impossible speed, carving through enemies while explosions erupt around him and entire vehicles split apart from the force of his attacks
Industrial warzone with burning tanks, sparks raining from broken machinery, smoke and fire filling the horizon
Begins with aggressive handheld close-up on his glowing eyes, sudden speed ramp into full sprint, whip pans linking brutal kills, crash zoom during giant explosions, orbit shot while sparks and blood spray across the frame, heavy motion blur amplifying speed and impact, ending with the berserker roaring on top of a burning tank mountain while the battlefield behind collapses into flames and detonations, camera slowly circling around his silhouette as ash falls from the sky

translations.es:
Un berserker cibernético con venas de energía naranja brillante, mandíbula mecánica expuesta, y dos espadas de cadena llameantes girando violentamente en sus manos  
Carga contra un ejército masivo de soldados blindados a una velocidad imposible, abriéndose paso entre los enemigos mientras explosiones estallan a su alrededor y vehículos enteros se parten por la fuerza de sus ataques  
Zona de guerra industrial con tanques en llamas, chispas lloviendo de maquinaria rota, humo y fuego llenando el horizonte  
Comienza con un primer plano agresivo en cámara en mano de sus ojos brillantes, aceleración repentina a una carrera completa, whip pans enlazando muertes brutales, crash zoom durante explosiones gigantes, toma orbital mientras chispas y sangre salpican el encuadre, desenfoque de movimiento pesado amplificando velocidad e impacto, terminando con el berserker rugiendo en la cima de una montaña de tanques en llamas mientras el campo de batalla detrás colapsa en llamas y detonaciones, la cámara girando lentamente alrededor de su silueta mientras cenizas caen del cielo
translations.fr:
Un berserker cybernétique avec des veines d'énergie orange lumineuses, une mâchoire mécanique exposée, des doubles lames en chaîne enflammées tournant violemment dans ses mains
Charge dans une armée massive de soldats en armure à une vitesse impossible, taillant à travers les ennemis tandis que des explosions éclatent autour de lui et que des véhicules entiers se fendent sous la force de ses attaques
Zone de guerre industrielle avec des chars en feu, des étincelles pleuvant des machines brisées, de la fumée et du feu remplissant l'horizon
Commence par un gros plan agressif à la main sur ses yeux lumineux, accélération soudaine en pleine course, whip pans reliant des tueries brutales, zoom crash lors de gigantesques explosions, prise de vue orbitale tandis que des étincelles et du sang éclaboussent le cadre, flou de mouvement intense amplifiant la vitesse et l'impact, se terminant par le berserker rugissant au sommet d'une montagne de chars en feu tandis que le champ de bataille derrière s'effondre en flammes et détonations, la caméra tournant lentement autour de sa silhouette alors que des cendres tombent du ciel.
translations.ja:
サイバネティックなバーサーカーが、オレンジ色に輝くエネルギーの静脈を持ち、露出した機械的な顎、両手に激しく回転する炎のチェーンブレードを持っている  
彼は不可能な速度で装甲兵士の大軍に突進し、敵を切り裂きながら爆発が周囲で起こり、彼の攻撃の力で車両全体が分裂する  
燃え盛る戦車、壊れた機械から降り注ぐ火花、煙と火が地平線を埋め尽くす工業的な戦争地帯  
攻撃的なハンドヘルドのクローズアップで彼の輝く目から始まり、突然のスピードランプで全力疾走に移行し、残忍なキルをつなぐウィップパン、巨大な爆発中のクラッシュズーム、火花と血がフレームを横切る中でのオービットショット、スピードと衝撃を増幅する重いモーションブラー、燃える戦車の山の上でバーサーカーが咆哮し、背後の戦場が炎と爆発に崩れ落ちる中、カメラが彼のシルエットの周りをゆっくりと回りながら、空から灰が降り注ぐシーンで終わる
translations.ko:
사이버네틱 버서커가 빛나는 주황색 에너지 정맥과 노출된 기계 턱, 손에 격렬하게 회전하는 이중 불타는 체인 블레이드를 들고 있다  
불가능한 속도로 갑옷을 입은 거대한 군대에 돌진하며, 폭발이 주변에서 터지고 그의 공격의 힘으로 인해 전체 차량이 갈라지는 동안 적을 베어낸다  
산업 전쟁터에는 불타는 탱크, 부서진 기계에서 떨어지는 불꽃, 연기와 불이 지평선을 채운다  
그의 빛나는 눈을 공격적으로 핸드헬드 클로즈업으로 시작하여, 갑작스러운 속도 증가로 전력 질주, 잔인한 살해를 연결하는 휩 팬, 거대한 폭발 동안의 크래시 줌, 불꽃과 피가 화면을 가로지르는 동안의 궤도 샷, 속도와 충격을 증폭시키는 강한 모션 블러, 전쟁터가 불길과 폭발로 무너지는 동안 불타는 탱크 산 위에서 버서커가 포효하며 끝난다. 카메라는 그의 실루엣 주위를 천천히 돌며 하늘에서 재가 떨어진다.
translations.pt-BR:
Um berserker cibernético com veias de energia laranja brilhante, mandíbula mecânica exposta, lâminas de corrente flamejantes duplas girando violentamente em suas mãos
Avança contra um exército massivo de soldados armados a uma velocidade impossível, cortando inimigos enquanto explosões irrompem ao seu redor e veículos inteiros se partem pela força de seus ataques
Zona de guerra industrial com tanques em chamas, faíscas caindo de máquinas quebradas, fumaça e fogo preenchendo o horizonte
Começa com um close agressivo de câmera na mão em seus olhos brilhantes, aceleração repentina para uma corrida completa, whip pans ligando mortes brutais, zoom de impacto durante grandes explosões, tomada orbital enquanto faíscas e sangue espirram pela tela, forte desfoque de movimento amplificando velocidade e impacto, terminando com o berserker rugindo no topo de uma montanha de tanques em chamas enquanto o campo de batalha atrás colapsa em chamas e detonações, câmera circulando lentamente em torno de sua silhueta enquanto cinzas caem do céu
translations.zh-CN:
---
一个赛博狂战士，身上有发光的橙色能量脉络，露出的机械下颚，双手握着旋转猛烈的火焰链刃
以不可思议的速度冲入一支庞大的装甲士兵军队，在爆炸四起的环境中劈砍敌人，整个车辆在他的攻击力下分崩离析
工业化的战区，燃烧的坦克，破损机械中迸出的火花，烟雾和火焰充斥着地平线
开始时是一个激进的手持特写镜头，聚焦在他发光的眼睛上，突然加速进入全速冲刺，快速摇镜头连接残酷的杀戮，巨大的爆炸中使用快速变焦，环绕镜头拍摄火花和鲜血飞溅的画面，重度运动模糊增强速度和冲击力，最后以狂战士在燃烧的坦克山顶咆哮结束，战场在他身后崩溃成火焰和爆炸，镜头缓慢环绕他的剪影，灰烬从空中飘落
---
